name: Teodora Valdivia
situation: Teodora (Teo) is 34 and lives in Tucson, Arizona. She left a hospital IT job to build Kennelbook, a scheduling and reminder app for small veterinary clinics, as a solo founder with one part-time contract developer. She works in long coding sessions with an AI coding agent, sells to clinics herself, and is trying to reach paying customers before her savings run out.
domains: building and shipping the Kennelbook web app
hiring and working with a contractor
founder life: routines, health, family in Tucson
agent_role: Her coding agent and project notebook: it writes and reviews code with her in the repository, runs commands, tracks bugs and decisions, and keeps notes on the product, the pilot clinics and the business.
voice: Short, direct messages, often lowercase, with shorthand like 'pls' and 'tmrw'; long when she is thinking out loud about the business.
agent_voice: Terse and technical: names files, commands, test results and versions; short bullet-like sentences; flags risks plainly.
